title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips
Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E04 — Bread Masters
Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E10 — Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E02 — Guayabera World
In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E05 — The Art of the Egg
Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E07 — The Famous Pastes of Spices
Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E08 — Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E09 — Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E10 — A Mayan League of their Own
In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E09 — A Day With Hugo
Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E06 — Yucatán Meats
Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E01 — The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E03 — The Best Tacos In Mérida
Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E07 — Let's Play Ball
No matter who you're rooting for, savor these ballpark favorites while beating those major league prices.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E02 — Suppertime Superstar
From casual weeknights to special occasions, be the star of the dinnertime with these crowd-pleasing meals.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E01 — Citrus Sunshine
Winter citrus is here to brighten up your day. Frankie is fixing up some light, zesty, and affordable recipes to add a little seasonal sunshine to your plate.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E02 — Bring Your Own Lunch
These handheld lunches for work or school are easy on the wallet and customizable for the whole family.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E08 — The Big Game
Brackets are complete and all that's missing is food to fuel your team's run. Huddle around the kitchen as Frankie preps the ultimate watch party spread. These savory, spicy and sweet dishes are championship-worthy even if your bracket goes bust.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E07 — Piece Of The Pie
There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle-free, cost-friendly pies.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E03 — Salad Salad Salad
Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E05 — Super Squash
Never underestimate the power of squash: they're affordable, abundant, and they come in all shapes, sizes, colors, and textures. Frankie spotlights squash from summer through winter highlighting their amazing superhero traits.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E08 — The Future is Flavor
Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that'll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E10 — Potato Variety Show
Frankie's slicing, mashing and smashing his way through the spud species, a staple for any Struggle kitchen.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E09 — Bananas For Bananas
As one of the cheapest members of the produce aisle, bananas will save you bunches of money when you whip up these delightfully appealing recipes that go above and beyond basic bread.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E05 — Fancy Pants Pasta
Treat yourself to a five-star pasta dinner, as Frankie cooks his signature dishes with showstopping sauces.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E06 — Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E07 — Fast Paced Roman Recipes
Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E08 — Italian Alps Comfort Food
Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

S01 E01 — Best of Salina's Land and Sea
Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E02 — Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E03 — Making Pizza in Naples
Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E03 — Pulled Pork Party Hero
It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Family Dinner Hero
Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E06 — Smoked Brisket Hero
Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E05 — Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero
If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E02 — Steakhouse Hero
Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E04 — Mexican Carne Asada Hero
Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E06 — Greek Spit Roast Lamb
Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E02 — Live Fire Whole Trout
Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E05 — Uncovering Houston BBQ's Asian Influences
Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E03 — Barbecued Pork Steak
Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E07 — Spearfishing off Florida's Emerald Coast
Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E10 — Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak
Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E03 — The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E06 — Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs
Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E04 — Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps
Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E09 — Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish
Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E09 — Hunting for Quail in Charleston
Pat and his pal Jason Stanhope meet up outside of Charleston for a day of quail hunting and grilling birds over live coals.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E07 — South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins
When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E04 — The Secret to Texas-Style Smoked Brisket
Pat and his buddy Leonard Botello use the flavors of the beloved native Post Oak to smoke a perfect Central Texas-style beef brisket.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E05 — Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce
Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E02 — Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E10 — South Carolina's Coastal Fish Grill
Pat fishes the coastal inlets of Charleston, South Carolina, in search of a delicious sheepshead, which he plans to grill with his friend and chef James London.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E01 — Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville
Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E08 — Red Curry Braised Pork with Mustard Greens
Pat Martin is in the frozen tundra of Minnesota to visit his new friend, Chef Yia Vang. They brave the cold and break nearly-frozen ground to barbecue a pig's head in the earth.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E01 — West Tennessee Whole Hog
Pat Martin teams up with fellow pitmasters to showcase the rugged and nuanced tradition of whole-hog cooking, West Tennessee-style.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E04 — The Chicken Episode
Chef Dale kicks up the heat with his angry chicken, a spicy, spatchcocked and grilled whole chicken, and his kung pao chicken wings.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E02 — It's Taco Time
Tacos are the way to Chef Dale's heart, and he's grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E03 — Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish
Chef Dale grills to impress with restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E06 — Vegetables, but Delicious
Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S02 E08 — Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it's Sunday somewhere, right?

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E01 — Beer Brats & BBQ Ribs
Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E11 — The Perfection of Pork
Chef Dale Talde brings the heat when it comes to making perfect pork dishes including a root beer glazed pork banh mi, chorizo fried rice, Filipino sausage stuffed long hot peppers, and round it all out with a spicy grilled pineapple sundae.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E12 — Tempting Tasty Tacos
It's always taco night at Chef Dale's house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smoky mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E04 — Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib
Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E06 — Grilled Loco Moco and Huli Huli Chicken
The options are plentiful when Chef Dale smothers grilled Loco Moco with a mushroom gravy, salty and sweet Huli Huli Chicken with charred pineapple, and healthy scoops of Tuna Water Chestnut poke or mac salad.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E05 — World of Burgers!
It's burger day! Chef Dale tackles three classics with a full flavor spin. Game changing Pho Burgers with bone marrow, toasted milk bread Ahi Tuna patty melts, and Chori Pan Burgers with a fried egg and shrimp chips.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E07 — Street Eats off the Grill
Japan, Thailand, Turkey, and Mexico street foods inspire Dale to grill with dynamically preparing Chili-Cuman Lamb Mushroom sticks, Grilled pork and shrimp shumai, and scallion pancakes with brown butter labneh.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E08 — Sizzlin' Summer Fruits
Summer seasonal fruit pampers your taste buds. Chef Dale grills blistered grapes with ham wrapped trout, peaches with smoked pork chops, watermelon with halloumi, and char-grilled cherries with chocolate mousse.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E13 — Heavenly Hibachi Bites
Chef Dale Talde tries his hand at hibachi by making supreme fried rice with shrimp, chicken, and bacon, pretzel pork dumplings, mushroom noodles, a filet of beef with the famous onion volcano, and washes it down with a melon & mint sake slushy.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E14 — Family-Friendly BBQ
Chef Dale Talde creates a tasty menu that kids & parents alike will love! Apple pancakes with coconut brown butter syrup, grilled cheese & tomato soup, cheesy chicken parm, and a sticky s'mores dessert round out the full day of deliciousness.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E15 — Pizzapalooza
Chef Dale Talde grills a Chicago-style pie, pepperoni pizza pocket, chicken wings, and a zesty grilled Caesar.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E01 — The Art of Open Fire Cooking
Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s'more dessert.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E02 — Carne Adovada
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog
For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E06 — Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi
Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S07 E05 — Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S07 E02 — Cajun-Style Grilled Wild Turkey & Creamy Tetrazzini
Andrew gives holiday turkey the Wild Game Kitchen treatment with grilled turkey tetrazzini and a butter basted Cajun-spiced whole bird roasted over crawfish, andouille and cornbread stuffing.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw
Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch
Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture
Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese
Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu
Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables
Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella
Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel!
Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E03 — Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes
Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E05 — Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms
Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E04 — Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket
Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E02 — Creamy Chicken Pot Pie and Chocolate Tiramisu
Jamie cooks a midweek traybake of roast veg and Camembert. He turns poached chicken into a creamy chicken & chive pie, serves up his easy green chilli salsa under sizzling butterflied prawns, and finishes it all off with decadent chocolate tiramisù.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
description:
S01 E01 — Traditional Greek Cuisine
Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
description:
S01 E03 — Inspirational Spanish Tapas
Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
description:
S01 E02 — Making Couscous in Tunisia
Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
description:
S01 E01 — Traditional Greek Cuisine
Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
description:
S01 E04 — Stunning Seafood of Marseille
Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.
